records.title: Upgrade Next.js to patched RSC security release
records.body:
## Summary
- upgrade `next` and `eslint-config-next` to `15.5.15`, the patched release for the App Router / React Server Components denial-of-service advisories affecting the current app setup
- align `react` and `react-dom` to `18.3.1` so the app stays on a compatible React 18 line with the new Next.js release
- refresh `package-lock.json` to capture the upgraded dependency graph and remove the previously reported Next.js RSC DoS findings from `npm audit`

## Testing
- not run

records.title: feat: replace kasada with botid, switch to ai-gateway
records.body:
## Summary
- Removes all Kasada bot detection (client SDK, server handler, proxy route)
- Adds Vercel BotID client-side challenge + server-side `checkBotId()`
- Switches OpenAI calls to `@ai-sdk/gateway` (`openai/gpt-4o-mini`) with OIDC auth
- Keeps Perplexity via `createOpenAI` (no gateway support for Perplexity)
- Upgrades ai to v6, `@ai-sdk/openai` to v3, zod to 3.25.76
- Build verified locally

## Changes
- **`app/api/validate-statement/route.ts`**: `createGateway()` for OpenAI, `checkBotId()`, `maxTokens` → `maxOutputTokens`
- **`app/layout.tsx`**: `KasadaClient` → `BotIdClient`
- **`next.config.js`**: Wrapped with `withBotId()`
- **`middleware.ts`**: Removed Kasada handler, kept CORS + rate limiting
- **Deleted**: `utils/kasada/*`, `app/(kasada)/*`

## Post-merge
- Remove `KASADA_TOKEN` and `OPENAI_API_KEY` env vars (keep `PERPLEXITY_API_KEY`)
